closure_evidence_and_timing: Baseline review-time study and cost basis before ROI/business-case claims.
Reviewed expected decisions and predeclared thresholds before evaluation freeze.
Inspected files, rights, provenance, units, cadence, timestamp joins and event-based splits before data acceptance.
Version-matched equipment limits, sign conventions, modes, interlocks and action list before rule freeze; unavailable items remain out of executable scope.
Provider/data-flow, access, retention and secrets review before external processing or site access.
Scope, ownership, support and exit terms before delivery commitment.
Timing, freshness, concurrency and recovery requirements before integration qualification.
Low/base/high lifecycle estimate and affordability decision before implementation commitment.
